title: Vortex Cream Tobacco 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Cream Tobacco combines the smooth, familiar taste of classic tobacco with a rich and creamy vanilla finish. This timeless flavour strikes the perfect balance between bold and mellow notes, making it ideal for vapers seeking a comforting and satisfying vape. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides the perfect balance of flavour and vapour, making it well-suited for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices like pod systems and starter kits. The nic salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine relief, delivering a robust yet gentle vaping experience. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts are a more sustainable and cost-effective alternative to disposable vape bars, available in a convenient 10ml format designed for refillable vape kits. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Cream Tobacco is a versatile choice for adult smokers and vapers.
